clock: zLamb.bin float64 little endian, original index order
model: minimize integral_J (P-N0-S_X)^2 over piecewise-linear P with Lambda/2 <= Pprime <= 2Lambda
block_policy: T=2^floor(log2(tau_k)); construct whole J=[T/2,3T] for every required clock block
cutoff: sqrt(T/2), largest range in supplied block lemma; not fitted to zeros
phase: complete finite Euler product, primes p<=X and ALL powers m>=1; delta=0
load_evaluation: analytic Fourier hat loads, all powers truncated only with absolute proved tail budget; stable analytic smooth-load series
qp_variables: y_i=P(t_i)-N0(t_i); mass matrix divided by h
solver: ADMM with exact banded linear solves, no truth-based choices
root_policy: same original level k-1/2; locate in increasing model and interpolate; missing coverage stays missing
block_seams: do not sort or repair seams; evaluate actual neighbouring predictions from their respective fixed blocks; report seam inversions
validation_status: retrospective/exploratory: previous reference outcomes have been seen; no independent validation claim
no_posthoc_selection: no sweep or selection of cutoff, mesh, slopes or model parameters using zero errors; all adverse outcomes retained
checkpoints: atomic protocol/source hashes, completed block predictions, ADMM y/z/dual and logs; resume only matching configuration
